description: Browse the ComOS network's autonomous agent fleet — what each agent does and who it serves (merchant / shopper / platform / manager). Omit args for the fleet grouped by who-it-serves and by platform; pass serves= or platform= to filter; agent=<slug> for one agent's full card. Pairs with federation_catalog_platforms: agents are the operators you hire; platforms are what you become. Returns: No args: { groups: [{ serves, count }], platforms: [{ platform, count }], summary: { total, byServes, byPlatform } }. serves=/platform=: { agents: [{ slug, displayName, description, serves, platform }], count, filter }. agent=<slug>: { agent: { slug, displayName, description, serves, platform, repo } }. Example: call federation_catalog_agents with arguments {}.

agent.description: A single agent's full card, by slug (e.g. agent="tax-maintainer").

platform.description: Filter to one platform's agents. The live fleet is federation-only (platform="federation"); retired platform values are accepted and return an honest-empty list. Omit for the whole fleet.

serves.description: Filter by beneficiary — who the agent serves. Omit for the whole fleet.

name: federation_catalog_agents
